purpose: SP15 stage 1 (Q2 for the E upstroke): hold the function (B3 genome and flags), change the input (the cable: H01 skeleton 955432427 with the B3 soma held) at the same mesh. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-12-h01-topographic-strategy.md (stage 1 addendum).
executor_note: Runs on the Vast.ai box (NEURON 9.0.2). The donor directory docs/evidence/h01-e-morphology/ holds the converted SWC, the B3 fit and the human sweep exports (the npz files are copied to the box outside git).
image: braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 (reference image; not used by the local executor)
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed and is not an input. Only sweep 56 (200 pA) is used; the upstroke is read from spike 1.
evaluation: One parameter set at both inputs (donor anatomy as the mesh control, H01 anatomy as the test) = one evaluation.

base_candidate.note: B3 flags unchanged; nseg factor 1 instead of 9 for both runs so that anatomy is the only difference between them.

1.title: Stage 1: B3 genome on the donor anatomy and on the H01 anatomy at nseg factor 1, sweep 56
1.prediction: Mesh control: the donor-anatomy run at nseg 1 has a spike-1 maximum rise within 10 percent of the nseg-9 value 597.7 V/s. Test: if the upstroke is the function (somatic sodium), the H01-anatomy run stays within max(3 x mesh deviation, 10 percent) of the control; if it is the input (cable load), it moves by more than that. Reported, not banded: count, first spike, threshold and the post-spike level on the H01 anatomy.
1.rejection: The mesh control fails its 10 percent band (no reading; the mesh, not the anatomy, moved the upstroke), or the H01 anatomy does not spike at 200 pA (no upstroke to compare; recorded as a count contrast of the input).
1.unchanged: All B3 flags of m0-b3-currents.candidate.json; CVode 1e-10; recorded command plus bias; stop 2100 ms; record_soma_currents; the B3 soma sphere (13.73 um) is held on the H01 skeleton.
